surface: Air install/README previews, social artwork and manifest metadata
implementation: Four real Annotate editor captures use a generated synthetic three-page PDF, isolated contexts and both themes. Wide 1440x900 pixels; narrow 780x1688 pixels at 390x844 CSS / DPR 2.
README picture selects light/dark. Removed device-named iPhone/iPad legacy assets and active references.
OG artwork composes the real editor image, original mark and canonical Air CSS at 1200x630. Landing promise, OG/Twitter title and descriptive alternatives agree.
Manifest theme/background use #fafbfc, matching the light document theme; live HTML retains light/dark theme metadata.
Build checks the actual manifest image paths/types/dimensions/labels and social dimensions. Added negative missing-image/dimension tests.
Inventory now includes root/static/artwork HTML, exposing the still-legacy 404 as pending instead of claiming all visible sources migrated.

validation.required: PASS: format/lint/types, knip, 458 units / 47 files, production build, asset metadata/size checks, design and 18 portability checks.
browserSuites: standalone-tools (six real output workflows; generated demo PDFs and both shipped bitmap inputs)
editor-navigation (176 tool selections, 176 layouts, page/history persistence, Apply/Undo, search, expanded controls, reduced motion and forced colours)
validation.visualReview: All four published screenshots, full OG card, laptop 1280x720 and tablet 768x1024 in both themes inspected. Navigation covers all required viewport classes and enlarged root text.
validation.metadata: PASS: built manifest, 9 served PNG byte matches, OG/Twitter metadata and no Chromium installability errors.
validation.runtime: Application source and output algorithms unchanged. Original product logos and annotation fonts unchanged. No dependency added.

validationHistory: Phone generator initially targeted a hidden rail, then its picker click was covered by first-install cache feedback. Scoped the visible mobile list, dismissed the real notice before selection and reran all four captures successfully.
The stricter build checker exposed missing manifest data in two old unit fixtures. Updated fixtures to represent shipped assets and added negative cases; all 458 tests pass.
